jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Travel eSIM
jobs.jd_full:
About IDTDP:

IDT Digital Payments (IDTDP) is an IDT Corporation division, powering prepaid mobile top-up, eSIM connectivity, and digital gift cards across direct-to-consumer apps (including BOSS Revolution), retail, and B2B/wholesale channels such as the Zendit platform. The division serves customers in corridors worldwide, combining a consumer-facing product business with a wholesale/API business for partners and resellers.

The role:

This is a commercial product role for a consumer travel product, not a telecom or IoT connectivity engineering role. You will lead the design and delivery of new travel eSIM features and own the roadmap and product lifecycle end to end, interfacing with internal and external functions to deliver an unparalleled experience for international travelers and commercial success. Travel eSIM is a travel-commerce product: it has to work the moment a traveler lands, and it has to earn the next trip's purchase too. You own catalog and pricing, the purchase-to-activation funnel, and the partner economics behind cost and coverage – against major players in the space.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own the travel eSIM roadmap end to end, created and managed in line with market demand and business goals.
  • Lead the design and delivery of new plans and features, owning the full product lifecycle.
  • Conduct market research on traveler needs, market trends, and the competitive landscape to keep the roadmap ahead.
  • Own purchase-to-activation end to end (browse, purchase, QR/eSIM install, first connection).
  • Oversee development and launch to hit quality standards and customer expectations.
  • Own the metrics that prove it worked: conversion, activation, ARPU, repeat purchase, margin by corridor.
  • Own the data-plan catalog and pricing per corridor – balanced against local SIM cost, margin targets and competitors.
  • Work with roaming/wholesale partners on coverage, capacity, and cost.
  • Act as the roadmap stakeholder across multiple scrum teams – write PRDs and push prioritization into each sprint planning.
  • Partner with engineering, marketing, sales, and customer support on every launch and its performance afterward.
  • Equip sales channels with sales materials and support b2b onboarding process.

We expect from you:

  • 4+ years as a PM owning a consumer product end to end –from pricing through purchase, activation, and retention.
  • Experience in defining, building, and shipping complex, technical products.
  • Experience in collaborating with and designers, engineers, Q/A in an agile environment.
  • Experience in facilitating technical discussions about products and features and providing feedback for technical designs.
  • Working understanding of how eSIM technology functions but not at expert level.
  • Product analytics fluency (e.g., Amplitude, GA, Looker/Power BI) to run funnel analysis and A/B tests independently.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and data-driven decision-making.
  • Sharp, concise communicator who can turn a technical or pricing constraint into a one-slide business case.

    • Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience at, or competing against, a major player in the travel eSIM space
  • Prior experience in the travel space (OTAs, airlines, hospitality, or travel-commerce)

We offer you:

  • Remote b2b or on-site employment (Belarus-Moldova) work opportunity!
  • B2B Employment ($, gross).
  • Stable job with long-term growth perspective.
  • Competitive salary with annual performance review.
  • Really good hardware.
  • An exciting and challenging job with talented people around.
  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.
  • Compensation for professional training, seminars, and conferences.
  • Referral program – get rewarded for helping us grow the team with talented people.
  • Company-supported English classes to enhance your professional growth.

A few words about us:

IDT Corporation is a global communications company founded in 1990 and headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. We are industry leaders in prepaid communication and payment services and one of the largest international voice carriers. We are listed on the NYSE, employ over 1800 people across 20 countries, and have over $1.5 billion in revenues.

We are not ”another big IT corporation”— we encourage and support in-house entrepreneurs in developing their ideas into business actions.

Since you are looking at this, it seems you might be interested. Let’s connect for a chat 😉

Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Product Manager, Banking/Cash Advance
jobs.jd_full:
About OnePay

OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.

Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.

We’re an all-in-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high-yield savings, credit cards, point-of-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.

We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category-defining.

But what really sets OnePay apart is how we move. Our customers don’t have time to wait… and neither do we. This place moves fast, and we’re looking for people who are:

  • Ready to run

  • Hungry and driven by urgency

  • Exceptional at what they do, with low ego

  • Comfortable operating in motion

The Role

As a Product Manager on the Banking team at OnePay, you’ll own the roadmap and day-to-day execution for our Cash Advance product and other Banking features. You’ll leverage your technical, design, and analytical skills to directly shape how millions of customers manage short-term cash flow, while partnering with other teams to ensure seamless and scalable experiences across our app and point-of-sale channels. This role offers a significant opportunity to massively impact both our customers and our company. You will:

  • Design and ship the next phase of Cash Advance as we grow and scale massively

  • Drive the roadmap by understanding customer pain points, defining requirements, and shipping features

  • Bring real quantitative rigor to how we convert users, set limits, optimize repayment, and manage fee structure and unit economics

  • Partner closely with a cross-functional group of analytics, legal, engineering, design, risk, and servicing to keep the roadmap moving

You Bring

  • 3 - 8 years of relevant experience owning an overdraft, Cash Advance, or Consumer Lending product

  • You are not afraid to dig into the details and the underlying mechanics (limits, repayment, fees, etc.) - note: you do not need full underwriting depth

  • A track record of operating independently with minimal ramp-up

  • Strong analytical chops; comfortable working side by side with data and risk partners

  • Highly detail-oriented, thrives in a genuinely cross-functional environment

  • Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary, stock options, and health benefits from Day 1

  • 401(k) plan with company match

  • Remote-friendly (US), flexible time off (FTO), and opportunities for growth

  • A high-growth, mission-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact

Standard Interview Process

  • Initial Interview with Talent Partner

  • Technical or Hiring Manager Interview

  • Team Interview

  • Executive Interview

  • Offer!

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager | MENA
jobs.jd_full:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: to provide global access for everyone. We believe in transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey. That’s why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day across rising markets around the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers. We are global thinkers, we value diversity, foster creativity, and work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, based in South Africa, to develop our product offering across the MENA region.

This is a highly cross-functional role at the intersection of Payments, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Risk, Regulatory and Commercial teams.

You will be responsible for understanding the specificities of the markets under your scope and transforming them into scalable payment solutions for some of the world’s largest digital companies. This includes everything from identifying opportunities and defining the product strategy to designing financial and operational flows, working with local partners, supporting integrations and taking solutions through launch and scale.

You will act as the product owner for the region, connecting local market realities with EBANX’s global product strategy.

Besides conquering the world, your activities will be:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the local payments ecosystem, including consumer behavior, payment methods, financial infrastructure, regulatory requirements, market practices and competitive landscape;
  • Own new country and market expansion initiatives, working end-to-end from discovery and partner assessment to operational readiness, launch and scale;
  • Design and evolve payment solutions covering the complete financial flow, including topics such as pay-in, settlement, FX, refunds, chargebacks, reconciliation, reporting and remittance;
  • Translate complex market, merchant, regulatory and operational requirements into clear product strategies, requirements and scalable solutions;
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Technical teams throughout discovery, solution design and delivery, balancing market requirements with scalability and technical feasibility;
  • Work side-by-side with Regulatory, Legal, Risk, Treasury, Finance and Operations to design products and financial flows that are compliant, operationally sustainable and ready to scale;
  • Engage directly with global merchants to understand their business models and payment needs, supporting strategic opportunities, RFPs/RFIs and merchant-specific product discussions;
  • Build strong business cases and prioritize initiatives based on their potential impact on TPV, revenue, gross profit, merchant growth, operational efficiency, business continuity and EBANX’s competitive positioning;
  • Drive alignment across multiple stakeholders and countries, making trade-offs and ensuring teams have clarity on what we are solving, why it matters and what success looks like;
  • Ensure product decisions, flows and operational processes are properly documented, creating the necessary artifacts and playbooks to support Engineering, Operations, Commercial teams and future market expansion;
  • Stay close to market developments, competitors, regulatory changes and emerging payment trends, proactively identifying opportunities and risks for EBANX.

What’s mandatory:

  • Solid experience in Product Management, with ownership of products or complex initiatives from discovery and strategy through execution, launch and continuous improvement;
  • Proven ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, navigating ambiguity and making decisions in complex environments;
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect product decisions to commercial and financial outcomes;
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including Engineering and business/operational stakeholders;
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and translate them into actionable plans;
  • Excellent prioritization skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders simultaneously;
  • Ability to communicate complex topics clearly to technical, operational, commercial and executive audiences;
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to drive decisions without relying on formal authority;
  • Customer-centric mindset and the ability to understand the needs of both global merchants and local payment users;
  • Fluent English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Based in South Africa and comfortable collaborating with teams and partners across different countries and time zones.

What else would we like to see?

  • Previous experience in the payments, fintech, banking or financial services ecosystem;
  • Experience launching products or payment capabilities in MENA, Africa or other emerging markets;
  • Familiarity with regulatory environments and the ability to work effectively with Legal, Compliance and Risk teams;
  • Experience working with banks, acquirers, PSPs, payment method providers or other local financial partners;
  • Experience with market expansion or launching products across multiple countries;
  • Experience supporting strategic enterprise merchants or complex B2B product discussions;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Finance or a related field.

What we value in this role

We are looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Someone who can understand a new market, sit with a local partner to design a payment flow, challenge an operational process, discuss technical trade-offs with Engineering, navigate a regulatory constraint, support a strategic merchant conversation and then turn all of that into a clear product direction.

You should be comfortable operating in environments where the answer is not always obvious — bringing structure to ambiguity, connecting the right people and moving the business forward while building solutions that can scale beyond a single merchant or market.

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • Meal Allowance;
  • Transportation voucher (if needed);
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Birthday Day Off;
  • Semi-flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics stores, and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Contract hire (1099) with path to permanent hire contingent on contract option year extension)
jobs.jd_full:
Intro

At MO, we challenge the status quo and help government leaders shape the future. We engineer scalable, human-centered solutions that help agencies deliver their mission faster and better. Our teams blend product, design, AI, data, and modern software practices to modernize legacy systems, build new digital platforms, and deliver mission-ready products that drive sustainable change.

We live by our values—Integrity, Excellence, Courage and Curiosity. They guide how we build, collaborate, and lead. From cloud infrastructure and data engineering to AI integration and service design, we connect technology and experience to deliver outcomes that scale.

We’re building a company where technologists, designers, and builders can serve the mission, grow their craft, and help shape the future of digital government. At MO, your work doesn’t just make a difference, it advances the mission and helps build a more capable, trusted, and human government.

Overview

Looking to make an impact? We’re seeking a Senior Product Manager to support our client in the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). Through your product thinking, prioritization, and delivery expertise, you’ll help shape technology decisions for the VA that will impact millions of Veterans.

At MO you’ll collaborate with service designers, data scientists, and engineers to understand customer and user problems, define MVPs and mature solution iterations, lead implementation efforts, and develop adoption and change management plans to ensure success.

How will you spend your time? 85% of your time will be dedicated to billable contract work, with the remaining 15% focused on growing our product practice at MO, contributing to our culture, and supporting business development.

How will you be expected to use AI? We believe AI is fundamentally changing how we build solutions and drive outcomes for our clients. We thoughtfully leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and produce higher-quality deliverables. We value curiosity, experimentation, and a willingness to continuously evolve how we work as AI capabilities advance.

What makes a successful candidate? If you have experience driving solution life cycles from proof of concept to roadmapping and execution, and have a proven track record of fostering strong relationships between clients and cross-functional teams, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is remote.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate their vision into reality through prioritization, roadmapping, and requirements development

  • Lead and direct a cross-functional team of designers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver iteratively and incrementally

  • Balance business needs, user needs, and technical capabilities to deliver solutions that result in meaningful impact and outcomes

  • Proactively identify and manage risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs and communicate with internal stakeholders and leadership to ensure operational support for delivery

  • Set outcomes-driven success metrics and measure the impact of the work to guide future iterations and strategic decisions

  • Facilitate effective product strategy methods and agile ceremonies

  • Enable continuous solution feedback loop based on qualitative and quantitative data from clients, customers, and end-users

  • Communicate effectively with clients to ensure continuous alignment of team priorities

  • Engage relevant parties across the government ecosystem to collaboratively problem solve issues that impact our ability to deliver desired outcomes

  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery, documentation, and experimentation, and to strengthen analysis, communication, and decision-making.

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive work and improve team efficiency through responsible use of AI.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3 - 8+ years of product management experience in a relevant industry (for example software development, government technology, or civic technology)

  • Strong product thinking skills — taking a structured approach to moving from ambiguous problems to impactful solutions

  • Client relationship management and customer success skills

  • A design thinker and lean product thinker (e.g., hypothesis and experimentation driven approach to MVP definition); delivering using plays from design thinking including research, facilitating workshops, and enabling decision-making with clients

  • An outcome-oriented approach focused on delivering value to end users and clients backed by measurable, data-driven results

  • Experience aligning cross-functional teams and stakeholders around goals

  • Experience turning business requirements and user research findings into clear, succinct epics and user stories

  • Experience working in cross-functional teams using agile methodologies

  • The ability to set expectations, remove blockers, and hold the team accountable to deliver on contractual and client expectations

  • A desire to seek different perspectives, and ask for help when needed

  • Experience with accessibility and human-centered design

  • Ability to manage a team through change

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with the federal government (VA experience preferred)

  • Experience with Drupal CMS and Drupal best practices

  • Familiarity using service design-informed research approaches

Perks

  • A dynamic, high-trust environment with a diverse, mission-driven team

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

  • Meaningful opportunities for career growth and learning

  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Company-sponsored short- and long-term disability, plus life insurance

  • Company-sponsored parental leave

$48 - $57 an hour

Compensation

This is a 1099 independent contractor role with an hourly rate of $48–$57, depending on experience and qualifications.

Placement within this range will be based on the competency level of the candidate.

To ensure equity and consistency across our compensation system, MO applies a structured salary framework. Offers are made within the posted range based on demonstrated competency and experience. This range is non-negotiable to maintain internal and external pay equity.

Note: To ensure compliance with all state, county, and local employment and tax regulations, applicants must currently reside in one of the following states to be considered for employment with MO. Employment eligibility is also subject to applicable state labor laws and remote work registration requirements. This list will be updated periodically as our team expands hiring eligibility to additional states.

AZ; CA; CO; CT; DC; FL; GA; IL; KS; MA; MD; ME; NC; NJ; NM; NV; NY; OR; PA; TX; UT; VA; WA; WI.

Work Location & Travel

MO is a fully remote organization, with a preference for candidates located in the Washington, D.C. area. Candidates based in this location should expect to be on-site at client locations approximately 40% of the time. Candidates located elsewhere may be expected to travel up to 25% to support in-person collaboration.

The contracts this position supports require US Citizenship.

This position will remain open through September 12, 2026.

In support of the Colorado Equal Pay Transparency Act, and others like it across the country, MO’s job descriptions feature the starting range we reasonably expect to pay to candidates who would join our team with little to no need for training on the responsibilities we’ve outlined above. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and responsibility.

We’re MO

We build with purpose, deliver with precision, and measure success by the impact we create — for our clients, our teams, and the mission. All MO leaders are expected to lead with humility, embody our core values in their leadership, and to hold their team accountable to the same. MO leaders are expected to ensure we are always growing by tackling hard problems, being strategic, and learning from others.

If you’re excited to work with us but not sure you check every box, apply anyway! You may be just right for this role or another one.

MO is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive, equitable environment where everyone can thrive.

All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of any required background, reference, or security clearance checks consistent with applicable law and client contract requirements. Your job offer is contingent upon satisfactory completion of such background and/or reference check as applicable. Additionally, this position may require a government background investigation to be completed and adjudicated dependent on your role and project. This offer will be withdrawn if any of the above conditions are not satisfied.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Manager Enablement, Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Toast

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Role Overview

The Manager Enablement Program Manageris the strategic architect responsible for enabling, scaling, and governing the holistic onboarding, continuous development, and coaching infrastructure for people managers globally across Customer Care and Customer Success (CS). This senior individual contributor role defines how Toast builds its leadership bench and empowers managers to transform talent into high-performing contributors within a complex operational ecosystem.

Serving as a thought leader within the Enablement organization and a trusted partner to Care and CS Directors and Senior Leaders, this role bridges the gap between leadership development and business-critical KPIs. By applying advanced data analytics, adult learning principles, and modern AI tools, you will build a predictable, scalable ecosystem that equips managers to drive consistent team performance across key metrics such as CSAT, and Net Revenue Retention.  This role will guide managers through the governance of high velocity tech changes to policy, procedure, and platforms to ensure high adoption and clear post enablement impact.

A Day in the Life (Responsibilities)

Strategic Program Management & Governance

  • Design, contract, and scale end-to-end Manager Training & Enablement programs aimed at robust bench building, leadership development, and continuous professional growth.
  • Partner with Care Operations, CS and CSO leadership to shape the overall manager investment strategy bringing consensus and acquiring buy-in to a shared vision and roadmap.
  • Build and govern standardized coaching playbooks, behavioral rubrics, and coaching certifications to ensure global manager consistency and talent transformation.
  • Establish operational rhythms and governance frameworks that empower managers to effectively leverage insights tools and drive high-impact coaching sessions with AI based manager 1:1 dashboards and transcription analysis.

AI Coaching Modules & Ecosystem Innovation

  • Architect and transition the standard manager training lifecycle into a closed-loop system by designing, piloting, and scaling autonomous AI coaching modules and simulation systems.
  • Integrate AI voice and text-based role-play tools into a manager “practice arena” to simulate high-complexity coaching, performance management, and alignment scenarios to assist managers with the development of their direct reports.
  • Optimize modern AI tools and LLM-based tech to build engaging, hyper-personalized manager support tools that empower leaders to be highly effective.

Tailored Enablement Delivery & Architecture

  • Develop specialized, distinct enablement pathways that address the priority KPIs of Customer Care (TTR/C (Time to Resolve/Close), CSAT (Customer Satisfaction), Transfer Rate, and AHT (Average Handle Time)) and CSM KPIs (Save Rate, Churn Mitigation, Downsell prevention).
  • Drive key manager KPIs in Coaching Compliance, Coaching Effectiveness, and Manager Engagement.
  • Design, build, and iterate on the onboarding design for new managers, including newly promoted, as well as the continuous development and enablement of tenured managers.
  • Ensure managers are deeply versed on organizational, product, and process changes, and fully equipped to translate those changes effectively to their teams during Huddles and dedicated coaching sessions to ensure adoption and effective application by their agents.

Influence, Analytics & Evaluation

  • Align and influence cross-functional Senior Leader and Director-level stakeholders as a trusted thought partner, managing massive programmatic changes across distributed  teams.
  • Proactively identify global areas of opportunity to support managers and leadership, providing ready solutions backed by a high rigor of analytical and performance assessment.
  • Lead as a Center of Excellence globally, evaluating behavioral opportunity areas and structuring remedial manager initiatives both internally as well as shared with BPO partners.
  • Establish robust post-enablement measurement frameworks to evaluate learning impact, leveraging AI analytics to track real-world performance improvements and core business KPIs.

What You’ll Need to Thrive (Requirements)

  • 5-8 years of experience delivering high-impact enablement, training infrastructure, leadership development curriculum, or performance coaching strategies within a fast-paced SaaS, Fintech, or fast-growth tech environment.
  • Demonstrated ability as a senior leader to align cross-functional VP and Director-level stakeholders, manage massive programmatic changes, and drive process discipline across fragmented teams.
  • Proven domain expertise navigating both transactional/queue-based operational environments (Customer Care/Support) and relationship-driven commercial environments (Customer Success/Account Management).
  • A strong portfolio of work demonstrating the ability to take an ambiguous, loosely defined objective and turn it into a scalable, repeatable corporate program.
  • Bachelor’s degree required, with an advanced degree in Adult Learning, Organizational Development, or a related discipline highly preferred.
  • Power-user familiarity with modern customer stacks, learning tools, and data analytics dashboards (e.g., Salesforce, CRMs, LMS tools, and AI platform assistants).

Nice to Haves

  • Ability to leverage AI technology to deliver and measure proven learning impact, moving beyond traditional completion rates to extract deep leader performance insights.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI to analyze complex leadership learning opportunities, recommend and gain buy-in on the right solution for complicated business needs, and follow through to completion.
  • Prior experience managing managers and coaching coaches, as a force multiplier across a multi-team organization.
  • Prior experience working within the restaurant and/or tech space, or a deep personal understanding of restaurant operations and hospitality.
  • Self-motivated disposition with a relentless “fixer” mindset—the ability to see the big picture and solve root-cause problems rather than immediate symptoms.
  • Project management certifications (such as PMP or PMO framework familiarity) or a proven track record of applying formal project management methodologies to scale complex enablement lifecycles.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we’re hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Enablement Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Senior Enablement Project Manager

Toast is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Senior Enablement Project Manager, you’ll own the launch governance and readiness system for a portfolio of products, using strong project management skills and change management experience to drive product proficiency across our customers, partners, and employees. This role is critical to ensuring that as Toast’s product velocity accelerates, customers and Toasters can actually absorb what’s shipping, adopt it, support it, and get value from it.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and downstream enablement teams, including Care, Onboarding, Customer Success Managers, Learning Design, Knowledge, and Training, to define how launches get tiered, sequenced, and readied, and you’ll mentor Enablement Project Managers on the team as they plan and coordinate the work behind individual launches.

About this roll \* (Responsibilities)

  • Own the launch governance system for a portfolio of complex, cross-functional product launches with competing priorities and multiple stakeholders: define how changes get tiered, sequence work across teams, and set the readiness checkpoints that determine whether a launch is ready to proceed.
  • Act as an authoritative source of knowledge across Product, Product Marketing, and downstream enablement teams, and build the cross-functional alignment needed to coordinate teams that haven’t previously worked together.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risk with senior stakeholders: flag portfolio-level issues like conflicting timelines or launches missing an owner, apply root-cause analysis, and bring data-backed recommendations that gain buy-in from leadership.
  • Lead recurring cross-functional syncs and represent the launch portfolio to executive and senior stakeholders, adapting your message for technical and non-technical audiences and championing the value of the work.

jobs.jd_full:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world’s largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you’re looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you’ll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Technical Product Manager, Keyfactor Platform

Location: United States; Remote

Experience: Mid-Level

Job Function: Product Management

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

The Product Manager will join the Keyfactor Platform team, responsible for overseeing the product lifecycle for Keyfactor’s SaaS Platform, from ideation to launch and beyond. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong leadership skills, the ability to work cross-functionally, and a hands-on approach that includes owning the product backlog and working closely with engineering teams to deliver products that align with the company’s vision and objectives.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals.
  • Develop product roadmaps and prioritize features based on business value, customer feedback, and market demand.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and sales, to bring products to market.
  • Own and maintain the product backlog, translating features and functionality into clear, well-defined engineering tasks and technical requirements.
  • Create detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Work closely with engineering teams to oversee the product development process, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality products.
  • Monitor product performance, gather user feedback, and iterate on features to improve user experience and satisfaction.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related inquiries.
  • Communicate product updates and progress to stakeholders and executive leadership.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key partners and customers.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role in product management.
  • Strong understanding of product development processes and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to learn new tools, technologies, and concepts independently.
  • Comfort engaging with technical concepts such as PKI, cryptography, or enterprise security software, and working across Linux, Windows, and Kubernetes environments.
  • Experience with product management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or similar.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience in PKI, cryptography, cybersecurity, or enterprise security software.
  • Experience using AI tools to drive measurable outcomes, such as backlog grooming, synthesizing customer feedback, or drafting PRDs/User Stories.

Travel Requirements.

Up to 10% travel time required.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience.

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas.

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:

Trust is paramount.

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.

Customers are core.

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.

We deliver with agility .

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.

United by respect .

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.

Teams make “it” happen.

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities.

About the Role

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and results-driven Project Manager to oversee projects from planning and initiation through completion. The ideal candidate will be responsible for coordinating timelines, resources, vendors, stakeholders, budgets, and day-to-day project execution while ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to scope. The successful candidate should be comfortable managing multiple priorities, resolving issues proactively, maintaining accurate project documentation, and communicating effectively with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal teams.

  • Manage projects from initiation and planning through completion and closeout.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Develop and track project budgets, estimates, and costs.
  • Monitor invoices, expenses, payments, and overall project profitability.
  • Review project financial performance and identify discrepancies or cost risks.

  • Prepare project updates, reports, and documentation for leadership and stakeholders.

Documentation & Process Management

Problem Solving & Operations

Works closely with volunteer leaders and directly-impacted communities on the Grand Canyon campaigns.

Job activities include but are not limited to:

jobs.title: After Hours IT Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
RCC is a full service IT firm which provides solutions for the development and support of IT infrastructure. We serve a broad range of clients, from large complex enterprises to small and mid-sized companies.

We currently seek an after hours Project Manager with knowledge of Networking, Data Centers, and/or Infrastructure. This is a full-time salaried role and is 100% remote. Training is provided by the internal team and will take 3 - 6 months.

DUE TO THE INTENSITY OF TRAINING, WE ARE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WILLING TO MAKE A LONG-TERM COMMITMENT.

This resource will be managing projects and coordinating resources for “power events” for data centers globally. This work can be done remotely from your home. Hours/days vary depending on the time zone where the data center is located. Power testing tends to take place on weekends when no workers are in the office, so weekend work is essential.

Candidate will be working with the RCC project team as well as client IT teams. The focus for this position is to manage and perform power-ups and power-downs at multiple sites and data centers worldwide.  You will oversee all aspects of your projects, setting deadlines, utilizing various client platforms, governing responsibilities, and overall client satisfaction through proper communication and service improvements.

  • 2+ years of experience as a Project Coordinator / Project Manager OR related technical management role. A technician operating in infrastructure technology looking to switch to a management role is encouraged to apply
  • Candidate must be willing to work nights and weekends as these are the times that projects are implemented and likely planning meetings held.
  • Experience with technology database systems.
  • MS-Excel needed
  • Some ServiceNow experience is strongly preferred
  • Ability to schedule and run projects remotely
  • Coordination of Lines of Business, resources, and timelines.
  • Some networking experience / IT Infrastructure experience
  • Ability to work across several time zones and work with different cultures.
  • Ability to work as an individual contributor as well as a part of a high energy team.
  • Ability to process work quickly, accurately and with changing priorities.
  • College Degree preferred

Job Description

Ever wondered what it feels like to be a Senior Project Manager in Netcompany?

Joining us as a Senior Project Manager, you will support the planning and execution of enterprise IT initiatives. In this role, you’ll work closely with cross-functional teams and enterprise clients to ensure the successful delivery of projects on time, within budget, and to a high standard of quality.

As a Senior Project Manager you will:

  • Drive the delivery of IT projects across enterprise clients, managing day-to-day operations to ensure scope, timelines, and quality standards are met.
  • Coordinate internal teams and vendors, ensuring clear communication, accountability, and timely resolution of delivery issues or risks.
  • Assist in resource planning and allocation, working closely with senior delivery managers and technical leads to balance project needs and team capacity.

  • Act as a point of contact for client stakeholders during the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment on deliverables and maintaining a high standard of client satisfaction.
  • Contribute to team development, fostering collaboration and supporting junior team members with guidance and problem-solving assistance.

  • Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate across departments.
  • A proactive mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to escalate issues appropriately when needed.

It would also be a plus if you match some of the following:

  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients across sectors such as energy, finance, healthcare, manufacturing, or retail.
  • Exposure to cloud technologies, DevOps, or digital transformation projects.
